title: Do GTA 5 cheats work in GTA 6?
text: Do GTA 5 cheats work in GTA 6? GTA 6 is out in New Zealand and players are asking whether old codes carry over. Rockstar has not confirmed any GTA 6 cheat codes. Here are the GTA 5 cheats we will be testing. Invincibility: Right, X, Right, Left, Right, R1. Give Weapons: Triangle, R2, Left, L1, X, Right, Triangle, Down, Square, L1, L1, L1. Spawn Comet: phone 1-999-266-38. None of these are confirmed to work in GTA 6 yet, and we will update this guide once we have tested them.

title: GTA 6 cheats: what we know
text: GTA 6 cheats: what we know. Fans expect GTA 6 to bring back classic cheats. In GTA 5, invincibility was Right, X, Right, Left, Right, R1 and Give Weapons was Triangle, R2, Left, L1, X, Right, Triangle, Down, Square, L1, L1, L1. These may return in GTA 6, but nothing is confirmed.
